column1: # Nearest catalogued companion of each WHISP edge-on galaxy, transcribed from Garcia-Ruiz, Sancisi & Kuijken 2002,
# A&A 394, 769, Table 7 ("Companions to the galaxies in the sample within 100 arcmin"; only galaxies whose heliocentric
# velocity differs by less than 150 km/s from the host, or which show a clear interaction pattern, are listed there).
# d_comp_arcmin is the PROJECTED separation the paper prints, so it is a LOWER limit on the true separation and any
# external field computed from it is an UPPER limit.  n_comp is the number of companions the paper lists.
# "nan" = the paper lists no companion for that galaxy.
